shared_factory: Exact original ProductionSharedFactory, same provider JournalBudget; 96 ranks *32 SMs maximum
shared_extent: Source SHARED_BYTES is 65536 per SM, base RF_BYTES+SM*65536; 8192 describes operand double buffer, NOT full allocation extent
owner_schema: PC10/rank/SM/generation plus actual tile/template metadata; serial is40bit next request count, no replay of requests or acknowledgements
quiescence: All shared live/queue/calendar/resident/faults zero, open event journal, exact allocator and home identities; unknown fields fail closed
restore: Cold exact factory retained; instantiate original Memory through factory with saved owner, attach actual saved bytes/counters to its new BoundSectorProvider; no transaction calls or replayed events during reconstruction
payload_charge: Only actual retained sector bytes serialized, including partial validity; typed metadata exact serializer; new continuation journals separately priced
compound_query: query_visible identity -> exact immutable manifest query_homes -> addressed query_codes/query_exp bytes -> source FP4E8 decode -> bit identity of parent actual RF publication; U32 exponent two complement sign extension exact
compound_no_stimulus: Reconstruct fields ONLY from actual raw sector bytes, never expected tensors; validation is read-only and makes no ACK/transaction
